description: SMART UNITY was established in 2025. SMART UNITY has participated in 2 competitions nasa space challenge competitions.
summary:
Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to risks such as radiation, isolation, and altered gravity, which can affect their physical and mental health.

AstraHealth is a health monitoring platform that brings together astronaut health indicators and environmental data, including heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, oxygen levels, and radiation exposure.

Through health trends, monitoring insights, and scientific resources, AstraHealth helps astronauts recognize changes and make informed decisions about their well-being. This is important because early awareness of health changes can support astronauts in managing their health during long-duration missions.
details: AstraHealth is a spaceflight health monitoring platform designed to help astronauts monitor their health during long-duration space missions. It brings together health indicators, habitat conditions, and radiation observations through dashboards, trends, and monitoring signals. This helps astronauts recognize changes and make informed decisions about their well-being. The project was built using Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Neon, and Vercel. Its creative approach combines crew health and environmental monitoring in one platform. We considered usability, data accuracy, clear data sources, and responsible presentation of simulated data.
